authoring.provenance_note: Original designed geometry, all inferred. Requirement-linked parts cite the brief or design requirements. Research documents functional precedents, not shape coordinates. Display curves are reproducible RK4 calculations.

rounds.summary: The central scientific claim is under-specified at the instrument: trajectories are shown, but neither their governing dynamical model nor t
The instrument explicitly displays seed x=-0.200 and v=0.000, but both stage pairs are assigned to model coefficients (h/delta and beta/alph
The raised branch guard and its two tall supports stand directly in front of the C seed window. In the close view their outlines cross C's s
Both outcomes share one magenta color, and A/B in the phase title does not explicitly identify which trajectory is solid and which dashed. T
The tray extraction is convincing, but the large modules read as boxes resting on the tray: their visible perimeters do not resolve a repeat
The service tray reveals distinct boxes and a finned region, but the open view does not show a convincing simple power/data interconnection
All nine criteria scored 3; all open defects fixed.
